events.title: 40th Anniversary of Franklin in the Dark
events.description: First published in 1986, join us in celebrating 40 years of the beloved Canadian turtle, Franklin. Discover the series’ original drafts by author Paulette Bourgeois and illustrator Brenda Clark, alongside other terrific turtle tales! Visit the Osborne Collection to experience our exhibit.

events.title: Celebrate 60 years of Mimico Centennial Library
events.description: Throughout November, we're celebrating the 60th anniversary of Mimico Centennial Library ! Take a walk through history with our special historical photo display , featuring images and newspaper articles of the library and surrounding Mimico community through the years. Youth Hubs are a welcoming place for teens after school and in the summer, where helpful staff are always available. Free, nutritious snacks are offered daily. Drop by a branch with a Youth Hub or call the branch to find out more.

events.title: Saturday Chess Club
events.description: Join us on the 2nd floor every Saturday for a few games of chess in a welcoming environment. All ages and all levels are welcome. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to participate. Any unsupervised individuals under 18 will not be able to participate in the program. Please note: There is no chess club on Sat Nov 21 for our Big Fall Book Sale This is a drop-in program.

events.title: Robotics Workshops for Youth
events.description: Join Upper Toronto Community Robotics for accessible, hands-on robotics and engineering workshops for youth! These programs will help you build foundational skills in engineering design, safety, CAD software, 3D modeling, and introductory robotics coding. This program is for youth in grades 6-12. It is highly recommended to attend each session to build on your learning. Please register online.
